title: Alert rules, action groups and alert processing rules

videos.script: Lesson 10 found Thursday's incident by asking. Nobody should have to ask. {{ask}} An alert rule is a query on a schedule, with a threshold. When the answer crosses it, the rule fires. {{rule}} An action group decides who hears about it. An alert processing rule decides when nobody should. {{who}} Azure will not fire anything for you here. So you will run the rule's query yourself, window by window, and see exactly when it would have woken somebody up. {{end}}
